facts.fact: President Mahama told Parliament that under GIFEC's Rural Telephony and Digital Inclusion Project 1,561 of 2,016 planned sites had been constructed and 1,144 were transmitting live, with 417 awaiting activation and 455 at procurement.

facts.fact: President Mahama said the One Million Coders programme, launched in March 2025, completed a pilot in four centres (Accra, Kumasi, Sunyani, Bolgatanga) and expanded to a second phase with virtual sessions, projecting 400,000 trained by the end of 2026; no number trained is given.
